title: Alert Triage Checklist
summary: Confirm source, timestamp, affected host, user context, severity, enrichment, and escalation path before closing or escalating an alert.

title: Incident Severity Guide
summary: Classify incidents by business impact, spread, data exposure, operational disruption, and response urgency.

title: Evidence Handling Notes
summary: Preserve original logs, document collection time, record tool output, avoid destructive actions, and keep chain-of-custody notes clear.

title: Shift Handoff Format
summary: Summarize active incidents, pending tickets, watch items, blocked tasks, owner assignments, and next recommended action.

title: Threat Intel Intake
summary: Capture source reliability, indicator type, confidence, expiration, related campaigns, and recommended detection updates.

title: Post-Incident Review
summary: Record timeline, impact, root cause, detection opportunities, response blockers, control gaps, and concrete follow-up owners.
